findings.title: Auto-Dreamer publishes a strong ScienceWorld source-provenance package
findings.observation: The public uyffg/auto-dreamer dataset publishes ScienceWorld episode-level trajectories, step-level observation/action/reward records, writer outputs, trace indexes, evaluation split manifests and a fixed validation set. The dataset card documents 3592 ScienceWorld train episodes and 1819 test episodes, while the public ScienceWorld directories expose hundreds of MB of row-level JSONL evidence.
findings.scope_guard: Positive evidence for upstream source/trajectory-to-memory-writer provenance, not yet complete intervention-to-outcome provenance.

findings.title: Auto-Dreamer writer outputs carry receiver-auditable origin identifiers
findings.observation: The public dataset preview/schema includes trace_id, task_id, success, add_ops, gen_text and writer, while trace_index supplies the task description and action sequence and steps supplies observation/action/reward. These fields make writer output origin traceable back to source trajectories without rerunning the original agent.
findings.scope_guard: Traceability is limited to the public artifact semantics and does not prove the exact selected memory region or consolidator rewrite used in a reported evaluation.

findings.title: Auto-Dreamer public trace dataset stops before the causal intervention-to-outcome bridge
findings.observation: The inspected documented dataset layout is explicitly rollout trajectories plus memory-writer outputs. It does not document serialized consolidator rewrite transactions together with pre/post memory state, exact evaluated checkpoint, paired downstream outcomes and a run/verifier manifest. Therefore it materially improves source provenance but does not yet close the scheduled-Chat-native causal replay package.
findings.scope_guard: Inspected public dataset surface only; separate model/checkpoint or author archives remain open.

findings.title: Auto-Dreamer exposes a public checkpoint bridge and ScienceWorld consolidator checkpoint but their run binding remains unresolved
findings.observation: Hugging Face exposes uyffg/auto-dreamer-ckpt-bridge-public and uyffg/dreamer_sciworld_v2_step60. The latter is presented as Qwen3 safetensors, 15B parameters, BF16; both inspected pages lack model cards. Current public cache could not open their file trees, so exact bridge semantics and mapping to paper-evaluated runs are unresolved.
findings.scope_guard: Existence/model metadata is not an evaluated-run checkpoint certificate.
